manual.engineers_workbench.line2: The Engineer's Workbench is a professional worktable for the educated engineer. It is widely used to create items described by {0}Engineer's Blueprints{1}.{2}
manual.engineers_workbench.line3: A wide variety of blueprints can be crafted, as detailed {0}here{1}, whereas a few select ones can only be discovered in the world or bought from villagers.{2}
manual.engineers_workbench.line4: To use a blueprint in the Workbench, put it in the slot on the left of the GUI and the necessary ingredients in the six slots in the middle.{0}
manual.engineers_workbench.line5: The resulting items can then be retrieved from the right side. Hovering your mouse over these output slots will inform you exactly which materials are needed for each item.{0}
manual.engineers_workbench.line6: A secondary function of the Workbench is the modification and configuration of more complex tools and gadgets. The {0}Mining Drill{1}, {2}Heavy Plated Shield{3} or {4}Revolver{5} are examples of such items.{6}
manual.engineers_workbench.line7: When placed in the main slot of the workbench, it's use becomes that of modifying these tools by inserting applicable upgrades into the new slots that appear.
